# Build archetype classification — 10 deterministic types

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-build-archetypes.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated: 2026-08-09
Source: `public/data/field-analysis.json` (committed snapshot; no RNS dependency)

## Method

Deterministic classification — no clustering, no randomness. Each operator is
classified into one of 10 build archetypes based on three derived dimensions of
their token cascade:

- **leverage** = cache_read / input (how much you reuse vs fresh input)
- **velocity** = output / input (how much you generate vs take in)
- **construction** = cache_write / cache_read (how much new context you build per read)

Classification order (priority — first match wins):

1. **CONVERGENT** — P80 on all 3: leverage + velocity + construction
2. **KINETIC** — velocity >= 0.8
3. **Construction branch** — construction >= 0.02 (BUILDER / RECURSIVE / AMPLIFIER by leverage)
4. **Reuse depth branch** — else (INPUT-BOUND / PRIMING / CONTEXTUAL / DEEP READER / ARCHIVIST by leverage)

CONVERGENT is checked first and pulls out operators who are elite on all three
dimensions. KINETIC captures high-velocity generation. The Construction branch
captures active context builders (construction >= 0.02). The Reuse Depth branch
captures passive context reusers. Each type is defined by a different primary
dimension of the token cascade.

6 of 10 types fall in the 8-12% population range. BUILDER (17.5%) is the
largest type — the construction branch captures all operators with active
cache writing (construction >= 0.02) and leverage < 30. CONVERGENT (6.6%)
and KINETIC (7.1%) are smaller by design — they're priority classifications
that pull operators out of other categories.

## Reproducibility

```
node scripts/gen-build-archetypes.mjs
```

Deterministic: same input → same output. No randomness, no K-Means, no
silhouette scores. The classification is a pure function of the three derived
ratios.

## Comparison to previous system

The previous system used K-Means clustering on log(yield, leverage, velocity,
SNR) with a hybrid two-stage approach (3 yield tiers + composition sub-shapes).
That produced 8 population clusters with silhouette scores of 0.544 (stage 1)
and 0.377 (flat). The new system is deterministic — no clustering artifacts, no
random seed dependency, no silhouette. Each type has a clear definition based on
which dimension of the token cascade dominates.
